versos.hebraico: וּבִ֨נְיָמִ֔ן הוֹלִ֖יד אֶת־בֶּ֣לַע בְּכֹר֑וֹ אַשְׁבֵּל֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וְאַחְרַ֖ח הַשְּׁלִישִֽׁי׃

controles.web: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
controles.kjv: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
controles.livre: Benjamim gerou a Belá seu primogênito, Asbel o segundo, Aará o terceiro,

versos.hebraico: נוֹחָה֙ הָֽרְבִיעִ֔י וְרָפָ֖א הַחֲמִישִֽׁי׃ס

controles.web: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
controles.kjv: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
controles.livre: Noá o quarto, e Rafa o quinto.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּהְי֥וּ בָנִ֖ים לְבָ֑לַע אַדָּ֥ר וְגֵרָ֖א וַאֲבִיהֽוּד׃

controles.web: Bela had sons: Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,
controles.kjv: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,
controles.livre: E os filhos de Belá foram: Adar, Gera, Abiúde,

versos.hebraico: וַאֲבִישׁ֥וּעַ וְנַעֲמָ֖ן וַאֲחֽוֹחַ׃

controles.web: and Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,
controles.kjv: And Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,
controles.livre: Abisua, Naamã, Aoá,

versos.hebraico: וְגֵרָ֥א וּשְׁפוּפָ֖ן וְחוּרָֽם׃

controles.web: and Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.
controles.kjv: And Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.
controles.livre: Gera, Sefufá, e Hurão.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֣י אֵח֑וּד אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֞ם רָאשֵׁ֤י אָבוֹת֙ לְי֣וֹשְׁבֵי גֶ֔בַע וַיַּגְל֖וּם אֶל־מָנָֽחַת׃

controles.web: These are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, and they carried them captive to Manahath:
controles.kjv: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:
controles.livre: E estes foram os filhos de Eúde, os quais foram os cabeças das famílias dos moradores em Geba, que foram levados cativos a Manaate:

versos.hebraico: וְנַעֲמָ֧ן וַאֲחִיָּ֛ה וְגֵרָ֖א ה֣וּא הֶגְלָ֑ם וְהוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־עֻזָּ֖א וְאֶת־אֲחִיחֻֽד׃

controles.web: and Naaman, and Ahijah, and Gera, he carried them captive: and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
controles.kjv: And Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.
controles.livre: Naamã, Aías, e Gera; este os levou cativos, e gerou a Uzá e a Aiúde.

versos.hebraico: וְשַׁחֲרַ֗יִם הוֹלִיד֙ בִּשְׂדֵ֣ה מוֹאָ֔ב מִן־שִׁלְח֖וֹ אֹתָ֑ם חוּשִׁ֥ים וְאֶֽת־בַּעֲרָ֖א נָשָֽׁיו׃

controles.web: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.
controles.kjv: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.
controles.livre: E Saaraim gerou filhos na terra de Moabe, depois que deixou a suas mulheres Husim e Baara.

versos.hebraico: וַיּ֖וֹלֶד מִן־חֹ֣דֶשׁ אִשְׁתּ֑וֹ אֶת־יוֹבָב֙ וְאֶת־צִבְיָ֔א וְאֶת־מֵישָׁ֖א וְאֶת־מַלְכָּֽם׃

controles.web: He became the father of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcam,
controles.kjv: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,
controles.livre: De sua mulher Hodes ele gerou a Jobabe, Zíbia, Messa, Malcã,

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־יְע֥וּץ וְאֶת־שָֽׂכְיָ֖ה וְאֶת־מִרְמָ֑ה אֵ֥לֶּה בָנָ֖יו רָאשֵׁ֥י אָבֽוֹת׃

controles.web: and Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.
controles.kjv: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.
controles.livre: Jeús, Saquias, e Mirma. Estes foram seus filhos, cabeças de famílias.

versos.hebraico: וּמֵחֻשִׁ֛ים הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־אֲבִיט֖וּב וְאֶת־אֶלְפָּֽעַל׃

controles.web: Of Hushim he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.
controles.kjv: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.
controles.livre: E de Husim ele gerou a Abitube, e a Elpaal.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֣י אֶלְפַּ֔עַל עֵ֥בֶר וּמִשְׁעָ֖ם וָשָׁ֑מֶד ה֚וּא בָּנָ֣ה אֶת־אוֹנ֔וֹ וְאֶת־לֹ֖ד וּבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, and Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with its towns;
controles.kjv: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:
controles.livre: E os filhos de Elpaal foram: Héber, Misã, Semede (o qual edificou a Ono e a Lode com suas aldeias),

versos.hebraico: וּבְרִעָ֣ה וָשֶׁ֔מַע הֵ֚מָּה רָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֔וֹת לְיוֹשְׁבֵ֖י אַיָּל֑וֹן הֵ֥מָּה הִבְרִ֖יחוּ אֶת־י֥וֹשְׁבֵי גַֽת׃

controles.web: and Beriah, and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;
controles.kjv: Beriah also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:
controles.livre: Assim como Berias, e Sema, que foram cabeças das famílias dos moradores de Aijalom, os quais afugentaram aos moradores de Gate.

versos.hebraico: וְאַחְי֥וֹ שָׁשָׁ֖ק וִירֵמֽוֹת׃

controles.web: and Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,
controles.kjv: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,
controles.livre: E Aiô, Sasaque, Jeremote,

versos.hebraico: וּזְבַדְיָ֥ה וַעֲרָ֖ד וָעָֽדֶר׃

controles.web: and Zebadiah, and Arad, and Eder,
controles.kjv: And Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,
controles.livre: Zebadias, Arade, Eder;

versos.hebraico: וּמִיכָאֵ֧ל וְיִשְׁפָּ֛ה וְיוֹחָ֖א בְּנֵ֥י בְרִיעָֽה׃

controles.web: and Michael, and Ishpah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah,
controles.kjv: And Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;
controles.livre: Micael, Ispa, e Joá, foram filhos de Berias.

versos.hebraico: וּזְבַדְיָ֥ה וּמְשֻׁלָּ֖ם וְחִזְקִ֥י וָחָֽבֶר׃

controles.web: and Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hizki, and Heber,
controles.kjv: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,
controles.livre: E Zebadias, Mesulão, Hizqui, Héber,

versos.hebraico: וְיִשְׁמְרַ֧י וְיִזְלִיאָ֛ה וְיוֹבָ֖ב בְּנֵ֥י אֶלְפָּֽעַל׃

controles.web: and Ishmerai, and Izliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,
controles.kjv: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;
controles.livre: Ismerai, Izlias, e Jobabe, foram filhos de Elpaal.

versos.hebraico: וְיָקִ֥ים וְזִכְרִ֖י וְזַבְדִּֽי׃

controles.web: and Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,
controles.kjv: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,
controles.livre: E Jaquim, Zicri, Zabdi,

versos.hebraico: וֶאֱלִיעֵנַ֥י וְצִלְּתַ֖י וֶאֱלִיאֵֽל׃

controles.web: and Elienai, and Zillethai, and Eliel,
controles.kjv: And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,
controles.livre: Elioenai, Ziletai, Eliel,

versos.hebraico: וַעֲדָיָ֧ה וּבְרָאיָ֛ה וְשִׁמְרָ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י שִׁמְעִֽי׃

controles.web: and Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,
controles.kjv: And Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;
controles.livre: Adaías, Beraías, e Sinrate, foram filhos de Simei.

versos.hebraico: וְיִשְׁפָּ֥ן וָעֵ֖בֶר וֶאֱלִיאֵֽל׃

controles.web: and Ishpan, and Eber, and Eliel,
controles.kjv: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,
controles.livre: E Ispã, Héber, Eliel,

versos.hebraico: וְעַבְדּ֥וֹן וְזִכְרִ֖י וְחָנָֽן׃

controles.web: and Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,
controles.kjv: And Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,
controles.livre: Abdom, Zicri, Hanã,

versos.hebraico: וַחֲנַנְיָ֥ה וְעֵילָ֖ם וְעַנְתֹתִיָּֽה׃

controles.web: and Hananiah, and Elam, and Anthothijah,
controles.kjv: And Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,
controles.livre: Hananias, Elão, Antotias,

versos.hebraico: וְיִפְדְיָ֥ה ופניאל בְּנֵ֥י שָׁשָֽׁק׃

controles.web: and Iphdeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak,
controles.kjv: And Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;
controles.livre: Ifdeias, e Penuel, foram filhos de Sasaque.

versos.hebraico: וְשַׁמְשְׁרַ֥י וּשְׁחַרְיָ֖ה וַעֲתַלְיָֽה׃

controles.web: and Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,
controles.kjv: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,
controles.livre: E Sanserai, Searias, Atalias;

versos.hebraico: וְיַעֲרֶשְׁיָ֧ה וְאֵלִיָּ֛ה וְזִכְרִ֖י בְּנֵ֥י יְרֹחָֽם׃

controles.web: and Jaareshiah, and Elijah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.
controles.kjv: And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.
controles.livre: Jaaresias, Elias, e Zicri, foram filhos de Jeroão.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֣לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֥י אָב֛וֹת לְתֹלְדוֹתָ֖ם רָאשִׁ֑ים אֵ֖לֶּה יָשְׁב֥וּ בִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס

controles.web: These were heads of fathers’ households throughout their generations, chief men: these lived in Jerusalem.
controles.kjv: These were heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Jerusalem.
controles.livre: Estes foram cabeças de famílias, chefes segundo suas gerações; estes habitaram em Jerusalém.

versos.hebraico: וּבְגִבְע֥וֹן יָשְׁב֖וּ אֲבִ֣י גִבְע֑וֹן וְשֵׁ֥ם אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ מַעֲכָֽה׃

controles.web: In Gibeon there lived the father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah;
controles.kjv: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife’s name was Maachah:
controles.livre: E em Gibeão habitou o pai de Gibeão; e o nome de sua mulher era Maaca;

versos.hebraico: וּבְנ֥וֹ הַבְּכ֖וֹר עַבְדּ֑וֹן וְצ֥וּר וְקִ֖ישׁ וּבַ֥עַל וְנָדָֽב׃

controles.web: and his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,
controles.kjv: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,
controles.livre: E seu filho primogênito foi Abdom; depois Zur, Quis, Baal, Nadabe,

versos.hebraico: וּגְד֥וֹר וְאַחְי֖וֹ וָזָֽכֶר׃

controles.web: and Gedor, and Ahio, and Zecher.
controles.kjv: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.
controles.livre: Gedor, Aiô, Zequer,

versos.hebraico: וּמִקְל֖וֹת הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־שִׁמְאָ֑ה וְאַף־הֵ֗מָּה נֶ֧גֶד אֲחֵיהֶ֛ם יָשְׁב֥וּ בִירוּשָׁלִַ֖ם עִם־אֲחֵיהֶֽם׃ס

controles.web: Mikloth became the father of Shimeah. They also lived with their brothers in Jerusalem, over against their brothers.
controles.kjv: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against them.
controles.livre: E Miclote, que gerou a Simeia. Estes também habitaram perto de irmãos em Jerusalém, vizinhos a eles.

versos.hebraico: וְנֵר֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־קִ֔ישׁ וְקִ֖ישׁ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־שָׁא֑וּל וְשָׁא֗וּל הוֹלִ֤יד אֶת־יְהֽוֹנָתָן֙ וְאֶת־מַלְכִּי־שׁ֔וּעַ וְאֶת־אֲבִֽינָדָ֖ב וְאֶת־אֶשְׁבָּֽעַל׃

controles.web: Ner became the father of Kish; and Kish became the father of Saul; and Saul became the father of Jonathan, and Malchishua, and Abinadab, and Eshbaal.
controles.kjv: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi–shua, and Abinadab, and Esh–baal.
controles.livre: E Ner gerou a Quis; Quis gerou a Saul, e Saul gerou a Jônatas, Malquisua, Abinadabe, e a Esbaal.

versos.hebraico: וּבֶן־יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן מְרִ֣יב בָּ֑עַל וּמְרִ֥יב בַּ֖עַל הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־מִיכָֽה׃ס

controles.web: The son of Jonathan was Merib Baal; and Merib Baal became the father of Micah.
controles.kjv: And the son of Jonathan was Merib–baal; and Merib–baal begat Micah.
controles.livre: O filho de Jônatas foi Meribe-Baal, e Meribe-Baal gerou a Mica.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֖י מִיכָ֑ה פִּית֥וֹן וָמֶ֖לֶךְ וְתַאְרֵ֥עַ וְאָחָֽז׃

controles.web: The sons of Micah: Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.
controles.livre: Os filhos de Mica foram: Pitom, Meleque, Tareia e Acaz.

versos.hebraico: וְאָחָז֙ הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־יְהוֹעַדָּ֔ה וִיהֽוֹעַדָּ֗ה הוֹלִ֛יד אֶת־עָלֶ֥מֶת וְאֶת־עַזְמָ֖וֶת וְאֶת־זִמְרִ֑י וְזִמְרִ֖י הוֹלִ֥יד אֶת־מוֹצָֽא׃

controles.web: Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah; and Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri became the father of Moza.
controles.kjv: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,
controles.livre: E Acaz gerou a Jeoada; e Jeoada gerou a Alemete, a Azmavete, e a Zinri; e Zinri gerou a Moza.

versos.hebraico: וּמוֹצָ֖א הוֹלִ֣יד אֶת־בִּנְעָ֑א רָפָ֥ה בְנ֛וֹ אֶלְעָשָׂ֥ה בְנ֖וֹ אָצֵ֥ל בְּנֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Moza became the father of Binea; Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
controles.kjv: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:
controles.livre: E Moza gerou a Bineá, cujo filho foi Rafa, cujo filho foi Eleasá, cujo filho foi Azel.

versos.hebraico: וּלְאָצֵל֮ שִׁשָּׁ֣ה בָנִים֒ וְאֵ֣לֶּה שְׁמוֹתָ֗ם עַזְרִיקָ֥ם׀ בֹּ֨כְרוּ֙ וְיִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל וּשְׁעַרְיָ֔ה וְעֹבַדְיָ֖ה וְחָנָ֑ן כָּל־אֵ֖לֶּה בְּנֵ֥י אָצַֽל׃

controles.web: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
controles.kjv: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
controles.livre: Azel teve seis filhos, cujos nomes foram: Azricão, Bocru, Ismael, Searias, Obadias, e Hanã; todos estes foram filhos de Azel.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֖י עֵ֣שֶׁק אָחִ֑יו אוּלָ֣ם בְּכֹר֔וֹ יְעוּשׁ֙ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וֶֽאֱלִיפֶ֖לֶט הַשְּׁלִשִֽׁי׃

controles.web: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Eshek his brother were, Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Eseque, seu irmão, foram: Ulão seu primogênito, Jeús o segundo, e Elifelete o terceiro.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיִּהְי֣וּ בְנֵי־א֠וּלָם אֲנָשִׁ֨ים גִּבֹּרֵי־חַ֜יִל דֹּ֣רְכֵי קֶ֗שֶׁת וּמַרְבִּ֤ים בָּנִים֙ וּבְנֵ֣י בָנִ֔ים מֵאָ֖ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֑ים כָּל־אֵ֖לֶּה מִבְּנֵ֥י בִנְיָמִֽן׃פ

controles.web: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and sons’ sons, one hundred fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons’ sons, an hundred and fifty. All these are of the sons of Benjamin.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Ulão foram guerreiros valentes, hábeis flecheiros; e tiveram muitos filhos e netos, cento e cinquenta. Todos estes foram dos filhos de Benjamim.
